description: This file defines a Python module for managing network interfaces, including classes and functions for retrieving and setting interface attributes such as address, flags, MTU, and hardware address, using ioctl system calls.

classes.name: Interface
classes.description: Represents a network interface, providing methods to get and set attributes such as address, flags, MTU, hardware address, and more, via ioctl system calls.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes an Interface object with a given index or name, retrieving interface details.

methods.name: __newIfreqWithName
methods.description: Creates an ifreq structure with the interface name.

methods.name: __doIoctl
methods.description: Performs an ioctl system call on the socket with the given ifreq structure and command.

methods.name: __getSimple
methods.description: Retrieves a simple attribute value from the interface via ioctl.

methods.name: __setSimple
methods.description: Sets a simple attribute value on the interface via ioctl.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Property that retrieves the interface index.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Property that retrieves or sets the interface name.

methods.name: flags
methods.description: Property that retrieves or sets interface flags.

methods.name: ifqlen
methods.description: Property that retrieves or sets the transmit queue length.

methods.name: metric
methods.description: Property that retrieves or sets the interface metric.

methods.name: mtu
methods.description: Property that retrieves or sets the MTU.

methods.name: hwaddr
methods.description: Property that retrieves or sets the hardware address.

methods.name: addr
methods.description: Property that retrieves or sets the IP address.

methods.name: broadaddr
methods.description: Property that retrieves or sets the broadcast address.

methods.name: netmask
methods.description: Property that retrieves or sets the network mask.

methods.name: sockaddrToStr
methods.description: Converts a sockaddr structure to a human-readable IP string.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the interface with its attributes.
